description: This file defines a custom view class 'AOK_KnowledgeBaseViewDetail' for handling the detailed view of a knowledge base article in a SuiteCRM module. It extends the base 'ViewDetail' class, overrides the display method to decode HTML entities in the description, and ensures proper HTML formatting.

classes.name: AOK_KnowledgeBaseViewDetail
classes.description: Custom view class for displaying detailed knowledge base articles with HTML decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to decode HTML in the description before displaying.

methods.name: setDecodeHTML
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in the bean's description field, replacing non-breaking spaces with regular spaces.
